executive_summary.headline: World-pillar hazards spiked—low Rhine levels, elevated energy costs, and tropical/seismic alerts in key sourcing regions—but supplier and peer risk have stabilized after volatile price moves this week.
executive_summary.next_step: Within 24 hours, confirm whether EVE Energy, Infineon, and Jabil stock drops on 21–22 Oct link to operational disruption or margin pressure, or remain unexplained; flag any India or China production impact from cyclone and earthquake alerts.
executive_summary.context: Rhine navigability constraints (Maxau and Kaub both below operational thresholds) and EU gas prices 31% above year-ago levels raise logistics and input costs across the region. India cyclone and China earthquake alerts add hazard risk near major assembly and battery-supply nodes. Supplier pillar cycled AMBER-GREEN-AMBER-GREEN over 30 hours, settling GREEN; three high-exposure suppliers posted outsized single-day losses with no confirmed cause, worth investigating for systemic stress or localize…
